children: child-a: type-definition-schema — the data schema for positive and negative types, the formal definition of 'pattern', and the unification mechanism. Foundation everything else reads.
child-b: mine-capability — scan a codebase and derive the initial pattern lattice (cold start). First capability because all others need patterns to exist.
child-c: digest-nighttime — batch processing of corrections into updated type definitions on Hex (M1 Studio 32GB, ollama). Measures the Hex capability assumption.
child-d: challenge-prebuild — adversarial type-check of proposed changes against the pattern library. The first visible payoff.
child-e: query-interactive — 'what matters about X while working on Y.' Retrieval against what digest computed.
child-f: pre-learning-vocabulary — seed the universal pattern catalog. Can run in parallel with mine.

child-g: constraints-lab-compiler — the mirror of the intentions lab compiler. Compiles the negative body from corrections, incidents, memory failure modes, and Akien's own mistakes into a derived surface. Same compilation mechanism as the intentions lab. Summarizes by why (dedup), not by count.
child-h: constraint-proof-lifecycle — founding incidents as measurements, live-catch as ongoing proof, retirement when the underlying cause is gone. The three states a constraint can be in.

child-i: training-ingestion — ingest from code (mining), chat logs/transcripts (corrections, CC--), CC memory files (failure modes), learning records, rulings, ticket histories (why fields, falsifiers), git history (tried-and-reverted), CLAUDE.md/Laws. Every source that carries evidence of what goes wrong.

child-j: dependency-query — the query capability (child-e) applied to the dependency structure itself. 'What matters about X while working on Y' includes 'what blocks X and what X blocks.' Not a separate audit artifact — the device answers dependency queries from its type system the same way it answers pattern queries. (Akien 2026-08-31: 'dependency query will be part of its job.')

questions.a: vs librarian: librarian anticipates from KNOWLEDGE (facts, documents, history), this device anticipates from PATTERNS (structural types, correction history). Different questions, same moment. Librarian is substrate; this device is consumer.
vs learning_block: learning_block is the engine for one block. This device USES learning blocks, is not one. The engine is a tool this device composes.
vs build_inspector: sieves are deterministic Python measuring structural properties. This device's challenge is pattern-based, learned, LLM-assisted. They compose.
vs constrain prebuild: this device may subsume the constraint prebuild step (Akien's words). Future possibility, not current collision.

vs intentions lab: the intentions lab compiles the POSITIVE body — what things are and what they're for. This device owns BOTH the intentions lab AND the constraints lab. The two are mirror surfaces compiled by the same mechanism, one positive, one negative.

vs CC memory: CC's memory carries ~14 failure modes passively. This device makes that body ACTIVE — contextualized to what's about to be touched, summarized by why, proved by live catches. Memory is a training input; this device is the operational consumer.

DESIGN POSTURE vs everything else: every other component was designed by a mind that starts from opportunity (Akien's cognitive style). Even the build_inspector measures constraints but was framed by opportunity-thinking. This device is the first component designed CONSTRAINTS-FIRST — the adversarial orientation is the design posture, not a feature.

watchme.trigger: A correction from Akien (CC--) on a pattern type the device's library already contains — the device had the type and failed to surface it at challenge time.
watchme.enough: The frequency of known-type corrections drops measurably over a sustained period. Novel corrections (unknown types) are expected and are the learning signal, not failures.
watchme.carrier: A verdict artifact against this ticket's falsifier: did the device catch the violation before code was written?
watchme.nexus: The device's own pattern library — a missed known-type correction feeds back as a strengthened negative type or a diagnostic of why the challenge missed it.
watchme.consumer: The device's digest mode — the correction enters the nighttime processing queue and updates the type definitions.

chart_claim: none — this ticket awaits /chart before BUILDME
dependencies: librarian graph trees (substrate — the embed seam this device consumes for pattern embeddings)
learning_block engine (the learning loop this device instantiates)
Hex.local reachable via inference proxy (for digest/nighttime mode)
